dict.string: The built-in AMap map component can show your current position on the map. This version of VisePanda does not turn that on and does not use your location.
VisePanda records only when you choose to speak a phrase for translation. Release or cancel to stop. VisePanda 仅在你选择说话翻译时录音，松开或取消即可停止。

VisePanda recognizes your selected recording on this device so you can review its text before translation. If local recognition is unavailable, type your phrase. VisePanda 在本机识别你选择的录音，供你核对文字后翻译；本机识别不可用时可输入短句。
